title: VLDL cholesterol

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: VLDL stands for very low-density lipoprotein. Some people call it a bad cholesterol because it can add to the buildup of plaque in the arteries. VLDL mainly carries triglycerides, while LDL mainly carries cholesterol.
context: VLDL is not usually included in routine cholesterol tests because it is difficult to measure. Because VLDL contains a certain percentage of triglycerides, a lab can use the triglycerides level to estimate the VLDL level.
aboveRange: A higher VLDL can be associated with buildup of plaque in the arteries
Factors that raise triglycerides, such as diet, may also affect the estimated VLDL
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
